gloss: to finish, to get by with

definitions.explanation: To bring something to an end.

definitions.gloss: to get by with, to make do

examples.japanese: {宿題|しゅくだい}を{済|す}ます。
{朝食|ちょうしょく}はパンで{済|す}ます。
examples.english: I make do with bread for breakfast.

examples.japanese: {用事|ようじ}を{済|す}ませてから{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'll go after finishing my errands.

notes:
{済|す}ます means to finish or get by.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {済|す}ます (transitive): to finish
- {済|す}む (intransitive): to be finished

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{済|す}ます: to finish ~
- 〜で{済|す}ます: to make do with ~
- 〜ないで{済|す}ます: to get by without ~
